assumptions: Exact C43 coding-edge eligibility and full original prior-gene blacklist are preserved by default.
All PBC census genes are excluded, although no PBC reserve was selected.
CC motif hygiene applies to native acceptors of donor-role sources as well as target acceptor-role sources.
Bridge control remains original AG-to-AC; no CC-specific bridge filtering is added.
Chromosome and strand are within-block strata, as in C43.
Hall capacities are optimistic six-port capacities; adding an independent seventh bridge can only reduce them.
Literal-minimum and sealed-reserve-only policies relax C43 prior exclusions and are sensitivity certificates, not recommendations.
not_run: No checkpoint loaded; no forward pass, CC score, AC re-score, confirmatory sample, or bridge search run.
No archived code imported or restored.
No repository test suite run because this work modifies scratch scripts only.

additional_PBC_history_GFS25_exclusions.hall_proof: A block consumes two distinct coding-source genes for each phase. For every nonempty phase subset S, 2*|S|*B <= |union eligible genes for phases in S|. The minimum floor over all seven subsets is the exact coding-only b-matching capacity in a stratum, before bridge/seam constraints. Sum stratum upper bounds per strand; balanced N <= 2*min(strand sums).

primary_fresh_capacity.reason: No plus-strand stratum can supply six distinct coding genes covering two of each phase; minus-strand maximum is one block before bridge, which also fails the minimum-two stratum rule.

strongest_claim: With the original C43 eligibility and prior exclusions plus the requested PBC census exclusion, there is no fresh strand-balanced complete crossed lattice; this is a construction feasibility result, not model or biological evidence.
